annotations.description: A present certificate pack has a non-active status, including packs with unknown expiry. Requires opt-in certs.packs and collector last success less than 10800 seconds old (three deployment polling intervals of 3600 seconds). Removed packs and previous statuses retire. Absent/stale data is not proof of health. For a non-default interval regenerate with GRAFANA_CERTS_PACKS_INTERVAL_SECONDS matching the deployment.
annotations.summary: Cloudflare certificate pack is not active

model.expr: (max by (cloudflare_certificate_zone, cloudflare_certificate_pack_id) ((cloudflare_certificate_pack{service_name="cf2otel",cloudflare_certificate_status!="active"} == 1) and on(instance) (time() - max by (instance) (cf2otel_scrape_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="cf2otel",cf2otel_collector="certs.packs"}) < 10800)) or on (cloudflare_certificate_zone, cloudflare_certificate_pack_id) (0 * max by (cloudflare_certificate_zone, cloudflare_certificate_pack_id) ((cloudflare_certificate_pack{service_name="cf2otel"} == 1) and on(instance) (time() - max by (instance) (cf2otel_scrape_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_name="cf2otel",cf2otel_collector="certs.packs"}) < 10800))))

spec.title: Cloudflare certificate pack is not active
